text.text: The RX-78 Gundam is a Japanese home video game console based on the Mobile Suit Gundam franchise. Released by Bandai in 1983, it was one of the earliest consoles built around a licensed anime property. The system featured cartridge-based games centered around Gundam battles and strategy gameplay. With a small software library and limited availability, the RX-78 Gundam console became a rare collector's item and an early example of the relationship between Japanese animation and video games.
